mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.drafterId, u.name AS drafterName, a.createdAt, a.updatedAt FROM approval a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.drafterId = u.id WHERE a.drafterId = #{drafterId} ORDER BY a.createdAt DESC
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.drafterId, u.name AS drafterName, a.createdAt, a.updatedAt FROM approval a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.drafterId = u.id ORDER BY a.createdAt DESC
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.drafterId, u.name AS drafterName, a.createdAt, a.updatedAt FROM approval a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.drafterId = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval (id, title, content, status, drafterId, updatedAt) VALUES (UUID(), #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{drafterId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE approval SET status=#{status}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
